title: Categorical Value Grouping for Thematic Symbology
description: Python and TypeScript packages with the same rules for named groups of the values of a categorical field in unique values symbology: comparing values, checking groups with messages for the person, carrying them over to new data, assigning named colours, making the classes and legend, and writing a MapLibre GL style expression. Both packages pass one shared set of test cases.
